# Liberation Sans

`LiberationSans-Regular.ttf` from Liberation Fonts 2.1.5 (https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts, release `liberation-fonts-ttf-2.1.5.tar.gz`), unmodified. SHA-256 `76d04c18ea243f426b7de1f3ad208e927008f961dc5945e5aad352d0dfde8ee8`.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`LICENSE`); authors in `AUTHORS`.

Krystal.Booey embeds it as its default and last-resort font (`codegen/bundled_fonts.py`).
